name: 箱线图与异常值诊断
description: 对最多 8 个数值字段绘制 300 DPI 箱线图或小提琴图，使用 IQR 识别异常值并输出具体行号、边界和原数据。
masterEvidence: 按字段输出 IQR 异常边界与具体行号
输出 300 DPI 多字段小面板诊断图

params.label: 数值字段
params.hint: 留空时分析全部数值字段；最多 8 个

code:
# E3 箱线图与异常值诊断：多字段小面板 + IQR 异常位置报告
import io
import math
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 10,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

NAVY = '#1F3A93'
ORANGE = '#E69F00'
GRID = '#E0E0E0'
selected_columns = {{columns}}
iqr_multiplier = float({{iqr_multiplier}})
chart_type = {{chart_type}}


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


def _style(ax):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#999999')
    ax.grid(axis='x', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, color=GRID, alpha=0.55)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
if iqr_multiplier <= 0:
    raise RuntimeError('IQR 倍数必须大于 0')
if chart_type not in ('箱线图', '小提琴图'):
    raise RuntimeError('图形类型必须是箱线图或小提琴图')

df = _to_frame(data)
numeric = df.select_dtypes(include=np.number)
if selected_columns:
    missing = [str(c) for c in selected_columns if str(c) not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError('找不到字段：' + '、'.join(missing))
    non_numeric = [str(c) for c in selected_columns if str(c) not in numeric.columns]
    if non_numeric:
        raise RuntimeError('异常值诊断只能选择数值字段：' + '、'.join(non_numeric))
    columns = [str(c) for c in selected_columns]
else:
    columns = [str(c) for c in numeric.columns]
if not columns:
    raise RuntimeError('没有可用于异常值诊断的数值字段')
if len(columns) > 8:
    raise RuntimeError('为保证图表可读性，一次最多选择 8 个数值字段')

by_column = {}
total_outliers = 0
for column in columns:
    series = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce')
    clean = series.dropna()
    q1 = float(clean.quantile(0.25)) if len(clean) else 0.0
    q3 = float(clean.quantile(0.75)) if len(clean) else 0.0
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lower = q1 - iqr_multiplier * iqr
    upper = q3 + iqr_multiplier * iqr
    mask = series.notna() & ((series < lower) | (series > upper))
    rows_found = [int(i) if isinstance(i, (int, np.integer)) else str(i) for i in df.index[mask].tolist()]
    values_found = [float(v) for v in series[mask].tolist()]
    by_column[column] = {
        'q1': q1,
        'q3': q3,
        'iqr': float(iqr),
        'lower_bound': float(lower),
        'upper_bound': float(upper),
        'outlier_count': int(mask.sum()),
        'outlier_rate': float(mask.mean()) if len(mask) else 0.0,
        'outlier_rows': rows_found,
        'outlier_values': values_found,
    }
    total_outliers += int(mask.sum())

ncols = 2 if len(columns) > 1 else 1
nrows = math.ceil(len(columns) / ncols)
longest_label = max([len(str(column)) for column in columns] + [0])
figure_width = 10.5 if len(columns) <= 2 else min(15.0, 11.0 + max(0, longest_label - 10) * 0.14)
column_gap = 0.28 if len(columns) <= 2 else 0.46
fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(figure_width, max(4.8, 3.0 * nrows + 1.8)), squeeze=False, facecolor='white')
for index, column in enumerate(columns):
    ax = axes[index // ncols][index % ncols]
    series = pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors='coerce').dropna()
    if chart_type == '小提琴图' and series.nunique() >= 2:
        sns.violinplot(x=series, color='#A8C5E5', inner='quartile', linewidth=1.0, ax=ax)
    else:
        sns.boxplot(x=series, color='#A8C5E5', width=0.42, linewidth=1.1, fliersize=4.5, flierprops={'marker': 'o', 'markerfacecolor': ORANGE, 'markeredgecolor': ORANGE, 'alpha': 0.8}, ax=ax)
    item = by_column[column]
    ax.set_title(f'{column}  ·  异常 {item["outlier_count"]} 个', loc='left', fontweight='bold', pad=9)
    ax.set_xlabel(column)
    ax.set_ylabel('')
    _style(ax)
for index in range(len(columns), nrows * ncols):
    axes[index // ncols][index % ncols].axis('off')

fig.suptitle(f'{chart_type}与 IQR 异常值诊断', x=0.07, y=0.975, ha='left', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#333333')
fig.text(0.07, 0.025, f'注：异常边界 = Q1 − {iqr_multiplier:g}×IQR 与 Q3 + {iqr_multiplier:g}×IQR；共识别 {total_outliers} 个异常单元格。', fontsize=8.5, color='#666666')
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.97, top=0.82, bottom=0.18, hspace=0.72, wspace=column_gap)
_buffer = io.BytesIO()
fig.savefig(_buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
image = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(_buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')
report = {
    'method': 'IQR',
    'iqr_multiplier': iqr_multiplier,
    'columns': columns,
    'total_outliers': int(total_outliers),
    'by_column': by_column,
}
return {'image': image, 'report': report, 'data': data}
